input_messages.content: Hey! So, I got this order with two tablets, but I only wanted one. The thing is, one tablet is pricier than the other, and I want to return that one and get a refund on my credit card. Can you help me with that?
Oh man, I don’t really remember my email right now. But I can give you my name and zip code. It’s Chen Silva, and my zip code is 46281. Does that work?

Wait, wait, wait. So you’re telling me I can’t get the refund for the gold tablet back on my credit card? That’s ridiculous! I only wanted one tablet, and now you’re saying I can’t get my money back the way I want? This is really frustrating.

Alright, since that’s the case, I want to return everything from both orders and get the refund on a gift card. I don’t want to deal with this mess anymore. How do we proceed?

Whoa, that’s a lot of stuff on those orders! But yeah, I guess if I can’t get the refund on my credit card, I don’t have much choice. Okay, I confirm—I want to return everything from both orders and get the refund on that gift card. Let’s get this sorted out.
No, that’s all for now. Thanks for helping me get this sorted, even if it was a bit of a hassle. I’ll keep an eye out for those emails and send the stuff back. Have a good one! ###STOP###
